name: Motivating Companion
body:
You have a talent for sharing your skills with others.

Prerequisite(s): Animal companion, mount, or familiar class feature

Benefit(s): If you have the bardic performance, aura of courage (or other paladin auras), banner, raging song, or the marshal’s aura class feature, you may choose to have that class feature centered on your animal companion, mount, or familiar instead of yourself.

Activating this ability is a swift action, though it activates automatically if you fall unconscious or below 0 hit points. In either case the shift lasts for 10 minutes, until you spend a swift action to return the class feature to yourself, or the original effect’s duration ends, whichever comes first.
